apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Created in the MyŠkoda app (version 8.16 or newer) under "API key". The key is bound to the vehicles selected there and expires after a while.

vins.label: Vehicles
vins.help: The API offers no vehicle list - every VIN has to be entered by hand.

pollIntervalIdle.label: Base interval (min)
pollIntervalIdle.help: 20 requests per hour is the hard limit. Below 5 minutes is not accepted.

pollBackoffMax.label: Maximum interval for a sleeping vehicle (min)
pollBackoffMax.help: A parked vehicle reports the same timestamp over and over. Polling it faster costs quota and yields nothing.

commandReserve.label: Requests reserved for commands
commandReserve.help: Polling stops once only this many requests are left, so a command still gets through.

commandTtl.label: Command lifetime (min)
commandTtl.help: A queued command that could not be sent within this time is discarded.

spin.label: S-PIN (auxiliary heating only)
spin.help: Only needed for vehicles with an auxiliary heater. Never store it in a state.

readParkingPosition.label: Read parking position
readParkingPosition.help: When switched off the position is not even requested from the API.
